title: Australian Keto Pavlova
description: A keto version of the classic Australian dessert, featuring a crispy meringue exterior and a creamy, sweet filling.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Sift the meringue mix into a bowl and add the egg yolks.
Mix well until stiff peaks form.
Spoon the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the softened Comte cheese and mix until combined.
Add the lemon juice and mix until stiff peaks form.
To assemble, place the cooled meringue on a serving plate.
Top with the whipped cream mixture and sprinkle with pavlova crumbs.
